Contract changes are exactly two fixed authority entries plus resolved_foreign_direct_imports; removing these additions restores the old contract object.

The unchanged raw9ab receipt is explicitly joined to fixed8ef path-binding records. All18 modules, selected paths, sizes, SHA256, final stat, selection values and optional source records match on the actual local inputs. kind is checked against exact module prefix. The original receipt remains unchanged.

The original sentinel is required verbatim and only the two pinned modules are adapted. Fixed source/object hashes are joined to original qualified P1 rows; Frozen has no direct project import and additionally matches its original borrowed provenance, while RoughMass imports the exact qualified Frozen object. The derived deps are explicitly labeled as authenticated source-name/object-pin joins rather than a field claimed to exist in the old record. No original source/authority is edited.

findings.details: Each selected native original path resolves strictly. Both logical and resolved paths must have the same current stat and both are retained in cache_before. The new symlink points to that resolved path. old_by_part uses the resolved identity expected by the actual probe while its provider records the original selected path. Fixed bytes/SHA are unchanged; no path mismatch is treated as a byte conflict.

The seven resource functions are unchanged from v1 and thus from approved v4 apart from the already-reviewed datetime qualification. service_observation checks a0..300-second bracket around the external observation and binds the request's submission-window declaration. It does not impose a runtime age limit: runtime_seconds_after_observation is recorded only. Therefore queue delay greater than300seconds alone does not reject startup. Actual submission time must later be joined to get_task. Startup and pre-first-Lean host memory, CPU affinity and disk checks still run, and the two actual PID/namespace/mount bindings must agree.
findings.honesty: The hidden-cgroup mode still states50ms sampled aggregate process-tree RSS, unknown task-visible cgroup budget, no hard-cgroup promise, no reservation and no completion/OOM guarantee.
